ala.text: Tezzeret grew up poor, and at eleven he fled Tidehollow with stolen etherium hidden beneath his skin and hair.

He apprenticed to an artificer, joined the Mechanists' Guild, and at 19 replaced his right arm with solid etherium before the guildmasters raised him to master status and sent him to the Academy of the Seekers.
Learning he was to be expelled, he murdered Headmaster Pannet, then broke into the vault and found the Codex Etherium a fraud; he was beaten, and his spark ignited.
He woke on Grixis, reached Nicol Bolas, and accepted his promise of power in exchange for servitude.

mbs.text: Tezzeret was working for the Infinite Consortium, and Jace agreed to join it before being sent to Thunder Junction to investigate an ancient vault.
After a failed mission to Kamigawa, Tezzeret beat Jace, and Bolas later broke through Jace's defenses at a meeting with Tezzeret.
Jace finally wiped Tezzeret's mind, bringing about the Fall of the Infinite Consortium.
Elspeth, Koth and Venser also freed Melira from Tezzeret's surgery room.

m12.text: Jace turned against Tezzeret and defeated him, then became the de facto leader of the Consortium's Ravnica cell and put its resources to work.
The change from Tezzeret the Seeker to Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas is cited as an example of Bolas's long-term collecting of relationships.

kld.text: On Kaladesh Tezzeret became Head Judge and identified Pia Nalaar as the Renegade Prime.
At the Inventors' Fair he stole Rashmi's matter transporter to make a Planar Bridge, and had Consulate enforcers seize every invention for safekeeping.
He set up a showdown with Pia and sent his automaton to kill her, but Chandra leapt into the arena and the Gatewatch emerged from the illusions behind her.
Tezzeret ended the fair and retreated into his airship, having used the whole spectacle as a distraction, and locked himself away to build his device.

aer.text: Declared Grand Consul with emergency powers, Tezzeret made the Aether Spire his secret base and had Rashmi's device turned into the Planar Bridge.
He dismissed Rashmi, claiming her invention as his own, and told his foes that the machine was in motion and their effort was too late.
The renegades and the Gatewatch cut off his aether, while Liliana overwhelmed him at the bridge and Chandra and Gideon crashed into it.
Tezzeret escaped by implanting the Bridge's core into himself and planeswalking away.

dbl.text: Tezzeret's name was whispered with fear on Kamigawa, where a nezumi village had been burned on his order, and the survivor Nashi grew up hearing it.
He appeared in a Phyrexian laboratory, explained that the experiments tested the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, and restrained Tamiyo while he held star-blades to Kaito's throat.
Later he took control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand and then on Tamiyo's, and dragged Tamiyo through a portal.
In the laboratory Tamiyo awoke Phyrexianized and loyal to Phyrexia.

one.text: Tezzeret bargained his Planar Bridge and the Reality Chip with Elesh Norn for a darksteel body, which enabled the infiltrations of Kaldheim and Kamigawa.
After the Phyrexian attack on Urza's Tower failed, he arrived with Rona's remains, blamed Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and told Norn that Elspeth Tirel led the Planeswalkers.

Norn kept her bargain and Jin-Gitaxias forged him a darksteel body, but then tried to bind him, having known of Tezzeret's and Urabrask's intentions; Tezzeret escaped by controlling a prisoner with Esper mind magic.

He went back to Tidehollow, where he grew up, sent the boy Estel to warn Rafiq as the Phyrexians invaded, then crossed overrun planes and resolved to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.

eoe.text: After the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret ended up on the Edge by unknown means and built a criminal consortium.
He contracted Sami and Tannuk to retrieve the Endstone from Sigma's Reach, and later entered their ship the Seriema, saying he had arranged events so that the stone would choose him as its conduit.
He said he would never serve again and wanted to know who made the Endstone, and he forced Haliya's armor to close on her when she objected.
A crystal dropped over a map pointed him toward Uthros, and he planned to sell the stone to its maker with Mm'menon's ship providing stealthy speed.
